quote: Establishes a U.S.-Colombia framework to secure resilient, diversified, and fair supply chains for critical minerals and rare earths, committing both governments to mobilize government and private sector support—via guarantees, loans, equity, offtake arrangements, insurance, or regulatory facilitation—to jointly identify and finance mining and processing projects within six months of signing.
note: Opened State.gov 8 Sep 2026 Barranquilla critical minerals framework release.
